newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks shift lower as traders take profits.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks shift lower as traders take profits.

text.p: MADRID, July 8 (Reuter) 1510 GMT - Madrid stocks closed lower on Tuesday as traders took profits against a backdrop of losses in most European bourses, dealers said.
The shift lower was seen as part of a consolidation process, with the indices expected to set new highs again soon on the continued influx of funds.
* General index down 4.36 points, 0.69 percent, to 623.79
* Iberdrola down 45 pesetas to 1,825 after BBV sold a stake of
around two percent in the utility, dealers said.
* Sellers particularly concentrated in Endesa and Telefonica
Dealers said trade was driven by technical movements, with selective buying in stocks perceived to have underperformed amid little corporate news.

"Really people are looking for excuses to move in and out of certain stocks, as we're now at levels which are not justified by fundamentals. But if the money continues to come in, shares will carry on climbing," said one foreign brokerage dealer.
Stocks are being boosted by swelling investment funds, as Spaniards look for alternatives to traditional savings instruments amid historic lows in interest rates.
Later this week focus will turn to June inflation, due Friday, and seen up from May's 1.5 percent year-on-year rate.
